items.name: APPLE
items.description: A crisp red apple that restores a small amount of health.

items.name: NECTAR
items.description: A sweet divine drink that restores a moderate amount of health.

items.name: SWORD
items.description: A well-forged blade that deals a reliable amount of damage to the boss.

items.name: BOW & ARROW
items.description: A swift ranged shot that deals slightly more damage than a sword from a distance.

items.name: SHIELD
items.description: A sturdy shield that absorbs incoming damage for a short time before shattering.

items.name: ZEUS' LIGHTNING
items.description: Zeus's bolt strikes vertically down the screen, dealing damage and briefly freezing the boss in place.

items.name: POSEIDON'S TRIDENT
items.description: Poseidon's spear lunges forward in a burst, leaving the boss more vulnerable for a short window.

items.name: HADES' HELM
items.description: Hades' helm of shadow grants complete invincibility, absorbing the next single hit no matter how powerful.

items.name: DEMETER'S WHEAT
items.description: Demeter's harvest gift restores a large amount of health, well above a standard heal.

items.name: HEPHAESTUS' MALLET
items.description: Hephaestus's forge hammer crashes down in a vertical slash. Grows more powerful with every use.

items.name: ATHENA'S AEGIS
items.description: Athena's divine shield bearing the face of Medusa. Significantly reduces incoming damage for a sustained duration.

items.name: ARES' SPEAR
items.description: Ares's war spear pokes forward dealing burst damage, leaving the struck side of the boss extra vulnerable.

items.name: HERMES' WINGED SANDALS
items.description: Hermes's sandals slow the boss's attacks and make them more vulnerable to damage during the slow.

items.name: APHRODITE'S LOVE POTION
items.description: Aphrodite's brew forces the boss to reset to idle, leaving them dazed and taking damage over time.

items.name: ZEUS' THUNDERSTORM
items.description: Zeus summons a storm cloud that rains lightning in escalating strikes, each hit more devastating than the last.

items.name: POSEIDON'S TIDE
items.description: Poseidon floods the arena in layered waves. Outgoing attack damage heals all teammates for the same amount.

items.name: HADES' RESURRECTION
items.description: Hades reaches beyond death to revive all fallen allies and grant every teammate ongoing healing.

items.name: DEMETER'S ABUNDANCE
items.description: Demeter's horn of endless plenty sustains all teammates with a generous heal over time.

items.name: APHRODITE'S CHARM
items.description: Aphrodite amplifies every player's strongest category, granting the whole team a massive buff across all categories.

items.name: ATHENA'S EDUCATE
items.description: Athena's wisdom transcends all boundaries, allowing item effects to apply regardless of house alignment.

items.name: ARES' RAGE
items.description: Ares ignites the battlefield in a massive explosion, dealing heavy damage and leaving the boss fully vulnerable.

items.name: HERMES' TREASURE
items.description: Hermes clears everyone's inventory and opens a divine chest, unleashing a frenzy of powerful random items.

items.name: HEPHAESTUS' FORGE
items.description: Hephaestus's legendary forge upgrades all common items to rare, with a chance of elevating rare items to divine.
